bases.name: Station 2
bases.notes: Operational suppression station verified by current municipal station roster.

drivingArea.locationNote: Estimated from Esri imagery and the mapped Bell Farm access geometry. The visible station apron and mapped internal service ways end about 15 m short of the Bell Farm Road centerline; the modeled rectangle spans that apparent paved access throat and the spawn is on the connected Bell Farm Road edge so local dispatch routes begin on the road graph. Canonical source coordinates above are preserved; no gate or apparatus entrance is claimed verified.

bases.name: Station 3
bases.notes: Current municipal About Barrie Fire page takes precedence over stale GIS address text: station 3 is 340 (GIS 350), station 5 is 361, station 6 is Mapleview East (GIS mistakenly West). Station 6 opened November 2025.

drivingArea.locationNote: Estimated from Esri imagery: station building, nearby parking apron and the mapped east-side service aisle that connects to Big Bay Point Road. The broader lot is shared with nearby commercial parking; the fit covers the visible station-side circulation only as an estimate, not an official parcel.

drivingArea.locationNote: Estimated from Esri imagery: station building, front apron and the mapped Ardagh Road frontage approach. Spawn is placed on the mapped road segment at the apparent driveway throat; exact apparatus entrance is not independently verified.

bases.name: Station 5

bases.name: Station 6
bases.notes: Current municipal About Barrie Fire page takes precedence over stale GIS address text: station 3 is 340 (GIS 350), station 5 is 361, station 6 is Mapleview East (GIS mistakenly West). Station 6 opened November 2025.

drivingArea.locationNote: Estimated from Esri imagery: Station 6 structure and the visible south-side access frontage near Tobias Lane. bases.name: Barrie Simcoe Emergency Services Campus
bases.notes: Current operator station list; operational deployment campus.

drivingArea.locationNote: Estimated from Esri imagery: Barrie Simcoe Emergency Services Campus building, the immediate access apron and nearby service aisle leading into the campus road network. The campus parking is shared; no EMS-only apron or entrance is claimed verified.

bases.name: Barrie Central East Post
bases.notes: Current operator station/post list confirms 31 Ross Street. Precise municipal civic address point verified in official Address VW layer, OBJECTID 15538 (Current).

drivingArea.locationNote: Estimated from Esri imagery: the small Ross Street post building and its narrow street-front approach. The modeled spawn is on the mapped Ross Street frontage because no internal service way is present at the site; no vehicle bay or driveway is claimed verified.
